title: Raid event
tagline: Create Event byu sing Messenger-Kit manages attendance , vote on Frames. Users can vote with ‘agree’, ‘deny’, or ‘maybe’. Automatic reminders and NFT minting are included.”
description: The project uses Messenger-Kit to create events and create attendance feature on Frames. Users can choose to "agree" , "deny" , "maybe" to participate in the event, refuse or participate in the event. When an event is about to arrive, it will automatically remind you that the event attendance time is about to end, and will close attendance when the event arrives. During the event, NFT will automatically be minted according to the previously set event name and image
how_its_made: The project uses Messenger-kit and XMTP protocol for chat function. This will make building a chat platform faster and simpler. Using crossmint and zora chain to create NFT collections and mints, this simplifies the speed of creating nft contracts and mint contracts. Use Redis database and KVstore vercel to store event and vote data. These databases will perform operations as quickly as possible so there is no delay. Use frames to manipulate the chat screen.
